string.text: Barrel with thread for silencer
Replacing the barrel with an elongated one, with a thread intended for installing a muffler.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets when firing a weapon, which increases the accuracy and accuracy of fire.
Barrel with modified rifling pitch
Allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet.
Protective coating
Applying a protective coating to weapon parts increases its service life.
Polymer buffer
The introduction of an additional polymer buffer into the recoil mechanism reduces the recoil felt by the shooter.
Anatomical handle
Selecting and installing grip pads that are more suitable for a particular shooter on a weapon allows you to achieve better results when shooting.
Adjusting the locking mechanism
By locking the bore more tightly, the obturation of the bore improves and the muzzle velocity of the bullet increases.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Lightweight store
The plastic magazine allows you to slightly reduce the overall weight of the weapon.
Chamber adjustment
Eliminating backlash makes it possible to improve sealing and achieve higher shooting accuracy.
Lightweight frame
Replacing a standard weapon frame with a lightweight analogue allows you to gain weight in the weapon, without losing in reliability and other characteristics.
Heavy Duty Parts
They have a higher resistance to wear, making the weapon more reliable.
Refinement of the extractor
Allows you to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts makes the trigger travel shorter and the trigger itself softer.This allows you to fire at a higher rate.
Lightweight parts

Replacing parts in the main components of the weapon with their light-alloy counterparts makes it possible to reduce the weight of the weapon without significant harm to its other tactical and technical characteristics.
